item.title: Amarillo Police Department warns of false power outage notification scam
item.description: The Amarillo Police Department warned community members to be cautious of a reported scam related to false power outage information, and advised residents to check for power outages through their provider's official websites or apps.

item.title: Pink Floyd laser show returns to Don Harrington Discovery Center
item.description: The Pink Floyd Laser Light Show: Dark Side of the Moon is returning to the Don Harrington Discover Center every third Saturday of the month.

item.title: Wayland Baptist University homecoming continues Tuesday with evening activities
item.description: For Wayland Baptist University, homecoming 2026 continues on Tuesday with "Library Mayhem" from 9 p.m. to 11 p.m. in the university library.

item.title: Texas Panhandle 'susceptible to drought' amid worsening statewide conditions
item.description: Most of the Texas Panhandle is considered susceptible to drought in the coming weeks, as statewide drought conditions across Texas reach the largest extent since October 2023, according to the Texas Water Development Board.

item.title: Panhandle Community Services Family Services Director runs for state board
item.description: The Panhandle Community Services Family Services Director, Audra Rea, is running for the Texas Balance of State Continuum of Care Board of Directors.

item.title: WATCH: Live Q&A with NewsNation's Brian Entin on latest developments in Nancy Guthrie search
item.description: Authorities have entered their third week in the search for Nancy Guthrie, the 84-year-old mother of 'Today' show host Savannah Guthrie, who is believed to have been abducted from her home near Tucson, Arizona on Jan. 31.

item.title: Texas A&M Forest Service issues preparation tips for possible fire weather threats
item.description: On Monday, Texas A&M Forest Service released information about preparing homes and livestock for evacuation due to elevated fire potential in the Texas Panhandle.

item.title: Wreck reported near downtown Amarillo Monday
item.description: AMARILLO, Texas (KAMR/KCIT) — Crews are working a wreck near SE 1st and Fillmore Monday evening that is impacting traffic. Information is limited, this page will be updated as information comes in.

item.title: Xcel Energy planning outages for Texas Panhandle amidst heightened fire risk
item.description: Xcel Energy announced that it is planning power outages for the areas of the Texas Panhandle Tuesday citing increased fire risk.

item.title: High wind warnings and fire weather concerns
item.description: Hello everyone, and welcome to President's Day! This afternoon will be mostly sunny, breezy, and unseasonably warm. Dry southwest winds of 15 to 30 mph will help temperatures soar into the 70's and low 80's. Amarillo should top out close to 80. Unfortunately, the wildfire threat could be with us today and throughout this week. [...]
